context.body: Before the flood arrives, God tells Noah that a covenant will be established with him and gives instructions for preserving his household and living creatures.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The first explicit covenant language in the biblical sequence appears inside a judgment-and-preservation scene rather than after the danger has passed.
observations.label: Covenant announced before the flood: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps Covenant announced before fulfillment visible within its covenant claim.
observations.label: Covenant announced before the flood: action, promise, or consequence

payload.posture: Read Genesis 6:17–22 as its own noah covenant setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places Covenant announced before fulfillment inside this covenant setting without turning it into a definition for every covenant passage.
payload.title: Covenant announced before the flood
